description.purpose: The episode table of this colony: one row per turn, append-only, with the two times kept apart -- happened_at is when it was said, recorded_at is when this colony learned it.
description.use_when: Behind a cell that speaks a recall port. The table is the memory; everything else is a query over it.
description.not_in_scope: No facts, no entities, no embeddings, no index of its own -- the columns are the whole model.
